name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for racing documentaries. Armed with a marketing degree and a passion for speed, he landed his first role at a local karting circuit, managing their social media presence and event promotions. His knack for connecting with fans and sponsors quickly became apparent, leading to roles with larger racing teams.

At ART Grand Prix Academy, Park focuses on building brand awareness and fostering relationships with sponsors. He believes in data-driven marketing, constantly analyzing campaign performance to optimize results. Park is known for his ability to blend traditional marketing strategies with innovative digital approaches, ensuring the team stays ahead of the curve. His pragmatic approach and strong work ethic make him a valuable asset to the team.

Park's distinctive ability to connect with both technical experts and casual fans gives him a unique perspective. He's skilled at translating complex engineering achievements into compelling stories that resonate with a wide audience.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled, short, with a subtle side part.
physical.description: Park is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas.
Has a habit of pacing when brainstorming.
Insists on starting every meeting with a brief recap of the team's latest race results.
